query: select jsonb_build_object('functions',(select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select p.proname,p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_arguments,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as result,p.proargnames,p.provolatile,p.proisstrict,p.proparallel,p.prosecdef,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner,p.proconfig,p.proacl::text as acl,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') as sha256 from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace='rakeezx'::regnamespace and p.proname=any(array['commit_enrollment_transfer','commit_enrollment_transfer_and_renumber','renumber_enrollment_roster','rename_score_item','plan_score_distribution','provision_account_workspace','provision_account_profile','complete_account_profile','begin_account_provisioning','contribute_curriculum_sync_bootstrap','finalize_curriculum_sync_bootstrap']) order by p.proname limit 24) x),'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text as function,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) as definition,pg_get_functiondef(t.tgfoid) as function_definition from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid where c.relnamespace='rakeezx'::regnamespace and c.relname in ('attendance','profile','notes','class_goals') and not t.tgisinternal order by c.relname,t.tgname limit 60) x)) as inventory

CREATE TRIGGER profile_provisioning_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF provisioning_state, provisioning_version, provisioning_hash, provisioning_manifest, provisioning_started_at, provisioning_completed_at ON rakeezx.profile FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION rakeezx.guard_account_provisioning_state()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.guard_account_provisioning_state()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- A caller may set a custom GUC; only a server-owned SECURITY DEFINER RPC
  -- may cross this guard. Direct authenticated table writes stay forbidden.
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' and
      (new.provisioning_state, new.provisioning_version, new.provisioning_hash, new.provisioning_manifest,
       new.provisioning_started_at, new.provisioning_completed_at)
      is distinct from (null::text, null::integer, null::text, null::jsonb, null::timestamptz, null::timestamptz) and
      (pg_catalog.current_setting('rakeezx.account_provisioning_control', true) is distinct from 'allow' or
       current_user <> (select pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
         where p.oid = 'rakeezx.provision_account_workspace(jsonb)'::pg_catalog.regprocedure)) then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Provisioning state is server controlled';
  end if;
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and (new.provisioning_state, new.provisioning_version, new.provisioning_hash,
      new.provisioning_manifest,
      new.provisioning_started_at, new.provisioning_completed_at)
     is distinct from
     (old.provisioning_state, old.provisioning_version, old.provisioning_hash,
      old.provisioning_manifest,
      old.provisioning_started_at, old.provisioning_completed_at)
     and (pg_catalog.current_setting('rakeezx.account_provisioning_control', true) is distinct from 'allow' or
       current_user <> (select pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
         where p.oid = 'rakeezx.provision_account_workspace(jsonb)'::pg_catalog.regprocedure)) then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Provisioning state is server controlled';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
